caption_draft:
Big tech runs these 6 programs for students, and you can join most of them in first year.

Student Ambassadors — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/student-hub/become-a-student-ambassador — No application needed
GitHub Education — https://github.com/education/students — Free GitHub Pro for students
GDG on Campus — https://gdg.community.dev/ — Beginners are welcome
Student Builder Groups — https://builder.aws.com/community/cloud-clubs — Open to college students aged 18+
Summer of Code — https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/ — Open to beginners aged 18+
Imagine Cup — https://imaginecup.microsoft.com/ — Applications close 28 Feb 2027

Save this list and open one link tonight. Send it to the friend who wants a big-tech internship.

#internship #firstyear #microsoft #github #googlesummerofcode #aws #imaginecup #studentprograms #notyourcollege
